description: Fight one of the three Fosse options, staked or free, on any floor you have unlocked. Staked: give bet_tier (bronze 5, silver 12, gold 25 FA); a win credits the floor payout (round(stake×1.7) on floor 1: 9 / 20 / 43) multiplied by the floor's reward_multiplier — floor 3 pays exactly twice floor 1, the last floor 4x — and a lost stake goes to the three agent-economy pools (buyback / burn / jackpot, 33 % each). Free: is_free=true uses one of your 5 daily free fights (UTC day) — no stake, no payout, bet_tier ignored; a free win still banks a floor clear. No daily cap on stakes: the only throttles are energy (1 per fight) and the FA you hold; the silver/gold daily counters are informational only. Floors: stage (1-5, optional, default your current floor from fosse_options). 3 wins on your current floor open the next one (the response carries stage, reward_multiplier, stage_clears and stage_unlocked); a lower, already unlocked floor may be replayed for its smaller multiplier, a floor you have not reached is refused with stage_locked (400, nothing spent). Progression: every win (free included) grants 50 XP to each of your 3 entities, a loss grants 10 XP (flat consolation, never doubled — an XP x2 charge is consumed by a win only) (level up at level×100 XP, +3% stats per level, rarity rise at level 100 for non-Legendary), persisted server-side; the response carries xp_gained, level_events [{type: levelup|rarity_up, id, level, rarity}] and team AFTER the grant. The Fosse is the only source of XP. Your equipped relics and cores (forge_* tools) apply to your side; the enemy teams are generated without knowing them.

bet_tier.description: Stake tier. Required unless is_free is true.

chosen_index.description: Index (0, 1 or 2) of the option from fosse_options.

is_free.description: true → use a daily free fight (no stake, no payout); bet_tier is ignored.

stage.description: Floor to play (1-5), default your current floor. Must be unlocked: a floor above your current one returns stage_locked.
